paragraphs.text: Slinn Voda is a leviathan from Dominaria .

The merfolk of the Voda Sea named their new home after their distant lost empire of Vodalia . But few on the surface realize that the sea shares its name with one of its inhabitants: Slinn Voda, a massive leviathan whom the merfolk appeased not long after their arrival. Slinn Voda bears a merfolk city on its back, and will rise to meet any true threat to the new Vodalian Empire.
